summary: Frontend-only verification of three follow-up fixes on TallyDekho (mock-first Expo web preview). All three pass: (1) Keyboard/search-blur on tapping top Pressable area — verified via document.activeElement transitioning INPUT->DIV; (2) Accordion single-open on Ledger Detail — tapping May 25 while Apr 25 was open leaves only May's rows visible (1 Sales Invoice), and re-tapping May collapses all (0 rows); (3) Voucher bottom action bar contains ONLY 'Share' — bottom-viewport scan shows 1 'Share', 0 'WhatsApp', 0 'Download PDF' (full-body text scan also 0/0). Regression: full-width search input rendered, fixed bottom Share button present, month accordion + inner ScrollView (rows scroll within expanded card) intact in code, info-pad icon still wired to LedgerInfoModal (setShowInfo/render present).

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking web-only warnings observed: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), TouchableMixin deprecated. Also 'Unknown event handler property onStartShouldSetResponder / onResponder*' errors in web console — RN gesture responder props leaking to DOM (likely from a Pressable/PanResponder path in accordion/date-range). No functional impact on mobile, but noisy on web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/ledger/[id].tsx and shared components.

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence web warnings.
Optional: audit responder props (onStartShouldSetResponder etc.) that surface as web console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: toggleMonth correctly implements single-open accordion: prev.has(mon) ? new Set() : new Set([mon]).
Keyboard.dismiss wired on top Pressable (stickyTop) and onScrollBeginDrag of expanded ScrollView — both paths correct.
ActionBar in DocumentPreviewPage now renders only a single Share TouchableOpacity; no WhatsApp/Download PDF buttons remain (verified in DOM at bottom of viewport).
